persistentBuyDock.visibilityRule: All four Buy destinations remain simultaneously visible after every tap and throughout vertical scrolling.

Wholesale.packModel: MOQ, case packs and landed prices
Wholesale.workspaceRule: Prices are discoverable by all; a verified workspace is required to place a Wholesale order.

Medicine.prescriptionRule: One saved or uploaded prescription is a parent record. A licensed pharmacist verifies each exact medicine line by identity, strength, form and quantity. Every approved listed line becomes addable without repeat upload; unrelated or mismatched medicines remain locked.

informationOrder: named fulfilment partner and partner type

cartIndicator.position: compact floating control above the Buy dock
cartIndicator.backgroundObstruction: must remain compact and must not replace a Buy destination

cart.groupingRule: Shop, Wholesale and Medicine retain separate fulfilment, payment, compliance, tax and order identifiers even when placed from one Cart.
cart.zeroItemRule: Removing the final item returns immediately to the relevant catalogue and replaces the empty Cart history state. No empty Cart page or View products extra tap is allowed.
cart.quantityRule: Shop starts at one pack; Wholesale starts at the selected MOQ; verified prescription quantities never exceed pharmacist-approved medicine-line quantity.

delivery.confirmationRule: One compact address confirmation appears before payment or purchase-order placement and returns directly after an address change.

orders.reorderAction: one editable Reorder action; no Reorder plus add duplicate
orders.support: One centralized Mool Assist with contextual AI-assisted response, in-app chat and in-app call.

motionAndScroll.userScrollFeedback: rate-limited low-volume detent tick and best-effort supported-device haptic
motionAndScroll.reducedMotionRule: disable optional motion and scroll feedback

nativeRules: Build isolated native Flutter V2 presentation only.
Never render MoolSocial Buy HTML in a WebView.
Reuse existing models, session, services, API adapters, authentication and native configuration.
Keep the legacy Flutter Buy presentation read-only until founder acceptance.
Do not modify accepted Screens 01, 02 or 03.
Do not rebaseline accepted Social or YouTube presentation.
Compare HTML and Flutter at identical route state, viewport and text scale.
Treat this version as immutable; any approved change requires a new version.
